items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 36:1
items.html: The record of Keter remains in the discernment of the vessel of Keter — that is, in the coarse light that remained below, which could not rise upward together with the light of Keter, as the ARI writes (Chapter 2, Item 10). And what he writes, that Keter did not make a discernment of a vessel, refers to the need of the second expansion. (Chapter 4, Inner Light, Item 9)
